pairs: The beginning of the Gospel of Jesus Christ,
Sicut scriptum est in Isaia propheta:
As it has been written by the prophet Isaiah:
Ecce ego mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam,
“Behold, I send my Angel before your face,
qui præparabit viam tuam ante te.
who shall prepare your way before you.
The voice of one crying out in the desert:
Prepare the way of the Lord;
et prædicans baptismum pœnitentiæ in remissionem peccatorum.
baptizing and preaching a baptism of repentance, as a remission of sins.
Et egrediebatur ad eum omnis Judææ regio,
And there went out to him all the region of Judea
et baptizabantur ab illo in Jordanis flumine,
and they were baptized by him in the river Jordan,
Et erat Joannes vestitus pilis cameli, et zona pellicea circa lumbos ejus,
And John was clothed with camel’s hair and with a leather belt around his waist.
et locustas et mel silvestre edebat.
And he ate locusts and wild honey.
Venit fortior me post me, cujus non sum dignus procumbens solvere corrigiam calceamentorum ejus.
“One stronger than me comes after me. I am not worthy to reach down and loosen the laces of his shoes.
I have baptized you with water.
ille vero baptizabit vos Spiritu Sancto.
Yet truly, he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
in diebus illis venit Jesus a Nazareth Galilææ:
in those days, Jesus arrived from Nazareth of Galilee.
et baptizatus est a Joanne in Jordane.
And he was baptized by John in the Jordan.
Et statim ascendens de aqua, vidit cælos apertos,
And immediately, upon ascending from the water,
he saw the heavens opened and the Spirit, like a dove, descending,
Et vox facta est de cælis:
And there was a voice from heaven:
in you I am well pleased.”
Et statim Spiritus expulit eum in desertum.
And immediately the Spirit prompted him into the desert.
Et erat in deserto quadraginta diebus,
And he was in the desert for forty days
And he was tempted by Satan.
And he was with the wild animals,
and the Angels ministered to him.
Then, after John was handed over,
preaching the Gospel of the kingdom of God,
and the kingdom of God has drawn near.
And passing by the shore of the Sea of Galilee,
he saw Simon and his brother Andrew,
mittentes retia in mare (erant enim piscatores),
et faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum.
and I will make you fishers of men.”
And at once abandoning their nets,
And continuing on a little ways from there,
et ipsos componentes retia in navi:
and they were mending their nets in a boat.
Et relicto patre suo Zebedæo in navi cum mercenariis,
And leaving behind their father Zebedee in the boat with his hired hands,
et statim sabbatis ingressus in synagogam,
And entering into the synagogue promptly on the Sabbaths,
And they were astonished over his doctrine.
erat enim docens eos quasi potestatem habens,
For he was teaching them as one who has authority,
Et erat in synagoga eorum homo in spiritu immundo:
And in their synagogue, there was a man with an unclean spirit;
Have you come to destroy us?
convulsing him and crying out with a loud voice,
And they were all so amazed that they inquired among themselves,
ita ut conquirerent inter se dicentes:
And what is this new doctrine?
quia in potestate etiam spiritibus immundis imperat,
For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits,
Et processit rumor ejus statim in omnem regionem Galilææ.
And his fame went out quickly, throughout the entire region of Galilee.
And soon after departing from the synagogue,
venerunt in domum Simonis et Andreæ,
they went into the house of Simon and Andrew,
But the mother-in-law of Simon lay ill with a fever.
et statim dicunt ei de illa.
And at once they told him about her.
And drawing near to her, he raised her up,
And immediately the fever left her,
Vespere autem facto cum occidisset sol,
Then, when evening arrived, after the sun had set,
afferebant ad eum omnes male habentes, et dæmonia habentes:
they brought to him all who had maladies and those who had demons.
et erat omnis civitas congregata ad januam.
And the entire city was gathered together at the door.
Et curavit multos, qui vexabantur variis languoribus,
And he healed many who were troubled with various illnesses.
And he cast out many demons,
but he would not permit them to speak,
departing, he went out to a deserted place,
And Simon, and those who were with him,
And when they had found him,
“Let us go into the neighboring towns and cities,
so that I may preach there also.
it was for this reason that I came.”
Et erat prædicans in synagogis eorum,
And he was preaching in their synagogues
Et venit ad eum leprosus deprecans eum:
And a leper came to him, begging him. And kneeling down,
he said to him, “If you are willing,
you are able to cleanse me.”
Then Jesus, taking pity on him,
he said to him: “I am willing.
immediately the leprosy departed from him,
and he promptly sent him away.
“See to it that you tell no one.
and show yourself to the high priest,
and offer for your cleansing that which Moses instructed,
quæ præcepit Moyses in testimonium illis.
At ille egressus cœpit prædicare, et diffamare sermonem,
But having departed, he began to preach and to disseminate the word,
ita ut jam non posset manifeste introire in civitatem,
so that he was no longer able to openly enter a city,
sed foris in desertis locis esset,
but had to remain outside, in deserted places.
And they were gathered to him from every direction.
